# out. Conservative: a group the RC section does not name stays unclassified.
# Seen on the board at 9bc82915 (docs/es3-cts-failures.md, "GC7000UL (i.MX8MP) failures by group"): picture and
# read-back verdicts the host never sees, so these causes are 'board-only' there. Narrow lines first: a blit from
# the window, an sRGB or 16F target and the R/RG integer attachments are named before the generic RC1 lines.
